    Dumb-bells in normal form ([mild] PDB, LDB) #

    DBN x y: arrows χ : x ⟶ x, μ : x ⟶ y, α : y ⟶ y with χ μ = μ α, μ α² ≠ 0, P(y, x) = 0, and the radicals of End x, End y generated by χ, α. DBData.toN builds it from case (DB) of [mild] Lemma 2.2. DBN.ldb: μ and α are the only arrows into y ([mild] LDB).
